summary: Phase 136D, independent verification plus documentation-only contract repair. Independently verified CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 (frozen 136C, docs/PHASE_136_STAGE_3_COMPANION_EXECUTABLE_SCHEMA_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md) against CLTR-CUTOVER-001, CLTR-CUTOVER-SCHEMAS-001, and Phase 136B directly, not merely 136B's restatement. Independently re-extracted the 62-item verification matrix (CSCH-EXEC-REQ-001..062, no duplicates, no gaps); reproduced findings CONFIRMED-136C-1 (digest shape) and CONFIRMED-136C-2 (matrix-count independence) as true by direct source inspection; reconfirmed PREREQUISITE-136A-1, PREREQUISITE-136A-2, and PREREQUISITE-136C-1 correctly disposed. Found and repaired, documentation-only, two genuine Blocking defects inside 136C's own frozen contract text: BLOCKING-136D-1 (Section 19/19.1's invented request-v1-to-package-to-request-v2 circular-reference resolution contradicted CLTR-CUTOVER-SCHEMAS-001 Section 6.1's unconditional readiness_package_id/readiness_package_digest binding and Phase 136B's own dependency diagram; repaired to the correct non-circular single-version creation order; CSCH-EXEC-REQ-047 updated to match) and BLOCKING-136D-2 (Section 34's CompatibilityState persistence path dropped the compatibility-state/ history subdirectory that Phase 136B Section 7's resolution of PREREQUISITE-136A-2 requires; repaired to match exactly). Disclosed, not repaired, PREREQUISITE-136D-1 (no JSON-Schema-Draft-2020-12-conformant validation engine exists anywhere in this repository -- pyproject.toml declares zero dependencies and the only existing schema-file consumers validate only required/additionalProperties key existence) and three NON-BLOCKING findings (family row-order cosmetics, an informal record_id prefix table, an unbounded free-text length gap), all scoped to Phase 136E. F-135Z-3 and PREREQUISITE-136C-2 are now genuinely closed. Contract verdict: VERIFIED WITH PREREQUISITES -- READY FOR EXECUTABLE SCHEMA IMPLEMENTATION PLAN, documented in docs/PHASE_136_STAGE_3_COMPANION_EXECUTABLE_SCHEMA_CONTRACT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md. This phase's own diff touches only documentation, status, changelog, and task-lifecycle files; it created zero executable schemas, zero fixtures, zero typed models, zero schema loaders, zero schema registries, and zero schema validators; it implemented no authority resolver, no authority-state persistence, and no authority pointer; it created no cutover request, readiness package, authorization, candidate, certification, publication attempt, conflict record, or recovery journal; it changed no authority epoch; it changed no production behavior. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative; runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. Recommended next phase: 136E -- Stage 3 Companion Executable Schema Implementation Plan.
